business_summary: Chai Communication Co., Ltd. engages in the advertising agency business in South Korea. The company offers various advertising solutions and services, including ATL, AI, application, BTL, brand film, banner advertising, creativity, contents, campaigns, consulting, DA, digital journey, design, e CRM, event, feed contents, goods, growth hacking. human-centric, HTML, interactive advertising, and identity. It also provides keyword marketing, log analysis, media-mix, metaverse, mobile, OOH, owned media, organic traffic, pop-up, promotion, print, performance, rich media advertising, retargeting, SMO, social marketing, SEO, TVC, tracking, targeting advertising, tech, UI, UX, viral film, virtual, website, and ZUA. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
